a.lede: If you're concerned about privacy, then you'll want to make sure that your smart TV doesn't have a camera - and that you disable it if it does.
a.title: How to tell if your smart TV has a camera (and how to disable it)

b.lede: If you have an older TV that doesn't have smart features, you might not need to upgrade. Here's how to turn your "dumb" TV into a smart one.
b.title: The easiest way to turn your regular TV into a smart TV
